_comment: Site changelog (changelog.html). Newest first. Features and new pages = entries with 1-3 short items (optional link, "shots": [...] — 2+ = carousel). Small changes = {"minor": true, date, category, title, optional link}: listed under the day, folded under a toggle when there are more than 3. Categories: Patch Reader, Materials, Hero Lab, Dynamics, Site. Add an entry in the same commit as the change. "fix": true = a correction of something that was wrong (shown with a pixel beetle).

entries.title: Weights: audit and nine fixes
items: Unit, enchantment and Spirit Bear rows no longer borrow the previous hero's ability multiplier; reworked abilities, new facets and item stat panes now count
Recipe cost changes with the same total cost score 0; item cost rows use one gold scale; an item's active effects are no longer priced as its stats
The value of a +1% change was refitted without hero base stats (it doubled spell damage and ability move speed); agreement with blind judges 0.35 → 0.40 and 0.43 → 0.46
With "Hide old" the line no longer jumps from a hidden column

entries.title: 7.41b Consecrated Wraps: a longer charge gain time is a NERF
Search moved to a loupe button in the corner
items: The round loupe above the weights button opens the search; the field slides out to its left and results open upward
Press / anywhere to search, Esc to close — the toolbar keeps only the tag and group chips

entries.title: Every item has a page — even without changes yet (133 more), and all of them can be picked into a hero page's item slots
Heatmap in olive and brick
items: Better values tint olive, worse ones brick — green and red pulled toward the site's gold; the middle of the column stays clear and the tint grows toward the ends
Applies to every table with the Heatmap switch (Mana Items, Hero Stats)

entries.title: Tag filters in one row, glowing like neon
items: Tags and group chips share one row, parted by a thin line — no "Tags:" / "Group:" labels (also on hero, item and unit pages)
A pressed chip glows in its own colour, letters and frame, like a neon sign
NEW and REWORK are brighter; DEL is wine-red now, no longer nearly the same as NERF

entries.title: Innate stat bonuses completed
items: Razor's innate is +1% move speed per level (was +1 flat); Death Prophet's move speed history corrected
New: Rubick +1 damage per level, Tidehunter +3 HP and +2 range per fish, Dark Willow +20% HP and mana regen
Hero Lab also counts Magnus and Primal Beast slow resist, Wraith King lifesteal, Death Prophet cooldown reduction; Centaur's Horsepower no longer stacks with boots

entries.title: Changelog: fixes are marked with a pixel beetle, the left list shows only features, screenshots share one width
Icon toggles (weights, talent, attributes) glow warm when on instead of turning solid gold, so the icon stays visible
Hero / Item Dynamics no longer stutter: hover is paused while the table scrolls and the diamond pop is instant
Talent icon redrawn like the game's emblem: a pale ring with a sprig on a dark disc, readable when the button is on
Hero Lab: the Difference stat list opens as a 4-column table — no scrolling
Warm colours
items: Cold steel greys and blues gave way to calm warm tones across the site: panels, lines, table headers, the calendar and its charts
Blue stays only where it means something: QOL, magic damage, Intelligence, Aghanim, mana

entries.title: Per Int on Mana Items
items: What one point of Intelligence gives (+12 mana, +0.05 regen) sits at the right of the toolbar — hover either for its patch history

entries.title: Terrain: the arrows next to the patch number step to the neighbouring map (7.41 ↔ 7.40) at the ends of the list
Mana Items: item history uses each patch's mana per Intelligence (11 in 7.36–7.38), not today's 12
Hero Stats / Hero Lab: 7.41f base attack speed fixed (Earth Spirit 95, Keeper of the Light 90, Warlock 95) — the data was stuck at 7.41e
Search, price and level fields use the pixel font for both the hint and what you type
Description paragraphs above the Materials tables are gone: the pages open straight on the controls
Warm pixel controls
items: Menus, filter panels, buttons and switches are warm pixel UI: pixel font, stepped corners, game-like buttons that turn gold when on
Tag chips (BUFF, NERF, NEW…) and group chips in the pixel font; Terrain's Zoom, Fullscreen and layer buttons match
Melee, ranged and talent icons redrawn as gold pixel art

entries.title: The current Materials section glows warm from below, like the coals under the header's embers

Opening a category puts its name at the top

entries.title: AoE Increase shows every radius again (it was empty since 7.41f)
Innate abilities are read correctly for 7.41f heroes
Silent changes for 7.41f compare the right data
Change chips line up in one column everywhere, also inside ability boxes and item property panels
A changed item value shows its BUFF / NERF chip next to the new value
7.38 proofread: Tormentor, Lifesteal, Heaven's Halberd, Abyssal Blade and dozens of tags
Lists inside "?" popups show a bullet per line

Changed abilities get before/after cards with the real old tooltip
Values that grow with game time open a table by minute; new items read as a card
